annotations.title: Live state of the covered call vault

description: The current on-chain state of the Kerne covered call vault for TSLAc on Base, read live in one call pinned to one block: epoch number, whether an epoch is live, whether sales are paused, deposit cap, total assets, the limits the vault enforces on any call it writes, the keeper, and the latest price round on its feed. It also lists what currently stops an epoch from opening. The vault is unaudited and its deposit cap is set by its owner; read deposits_open before assuming anyone can deposit.
name: get_vault_state
title: Live state of the covered call vault
